title: Mork & Mindy white egg as a hint of hidden knowledge

tellings.quote: The story goes and they show it in the preview of that show and it's part of every show is this white egg. He flew to Earth

plain: The 1970s television comedy Mork & Mindy, in which the actor Robin Williams played an alien who flew to Earth in a white egg, may have been a hint of secret knowledge, according to Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot who says he once carried a UFO. Barber points out that the white egg was shown in the preview and was part of every episode. To him it suggests someone behind the show knew what real craft look like.
